title: Arkimals — Halloween on Tari
summary: Halloween canine game on Esmeralda. Incubation delivers a surprise through an encrypted Tari memo; the player can preview it privately in Sapient before voluntarily revealing and minting a canine NFT. The operator knows the outcome and can delay delivery; timing, fees and account activity remain public. The October 29 public landing and rules views loaded without a wallet. The rules also describe breeding, staking and rebirth, which permanently retires the submitted canine. Current prices are shown before wallet approval. The recorded walkthrough shows public pages only; no incubation, private memo, mint or transaction was exercised. MIT code; existing Arkimals artwork has separate provenance in the repository.
cardSummary: Receive a secret canine through an encrypted wallet memo, then choose when to reveal and mint it.
